dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from the widest mid-body section towards the posterior peduncle, resulting in a smooth triangular geometric profile.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slightly asymmetrical lateral margins, with a localized outward bulge on the right posterior margin relative to the more linear left margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median intensity across the visible dorsal surface, indicating a near-mature or mature individual.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse grey mottling observed across the dorsal surface, with a slight increase in density around the anterior blowhole region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the pigmented grey regions and the lighter off-white baseline canvas.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced, sharp central dorsal ridge extending along the posterior half of the visible axis, creating a distinct longitudinal shadow.
